newsitem.title: UK: GGT relisting of shares delayed.
newsitem.headline: GGT relisting of shares delayed.

text.p: GGT Group Plc on Wednesday said completion of its proposed acquisition of French advertising agency BDDP and the accompanying relisting of GGT's shares has been delayed until the end of February.
But the delay merely reflects the many details involved in the verification of contracts required under the due diligence financial review of the acquisition, a spokesman for GGT said.
"It is simply an issue of a slight delay," the spokesman told Reuters. "The deal remains very much on target and both sides are looking to its completion. We've got two very buoyant agencies."
The spokesman said rumours that the deal looks rocky and could be derailed are completely unfounded.
When GGT last September announced its agreement to buy BDDP for 105 million stg, it said it expected to complete the deal and relist its shares in Januayr.
GGT had asked that its shares be suspended from trading on the London Stock Exchange pending shareholder approval and completion of the deal due to the size of the deal.
GGT in the year ended April 1996 had revenues 62 million stg. BDDP in 1995 had revenues of 1.135 billion French francs, equivalent to about 142 million stg.
GGT plans to finance the acquisition through about 20 million stg of new borrowings and a new equity issue to raise 55 million stg.
